## LightMoss v0.3.10: speaker safety on the R36S

**R36S (G80CA), both kernels:** the speaker is protected at start-up. The sound chip's clock used to start at a wrong
rate (100 MHz on 4.4, 600 MHz on 5.10) with the speaker amplifier already on, until the first sound set the right one.
On 5.10 that played noise through the speaker from boot to the first sound, and on another G80CA board it damaged the
speaker during a long first start. This is the "loud pop" LightMoss Kernel warns about. Now the clock starts at the
right rate (12.288 MHz) on both kernels.

**Under 5.10, also:** the speaker amplifier runs only while something plays, and the maximum volume is capped at the
same level as LightMoss's 4.4 kernel (and ArkOS). Both come from the 5.10 kernel's maintainer (jokubasver); 5.10 now
follows their latest version.

**Mini V2:** no change.

### Updating
*LightMoss Update* in spruce (charger connected when it restarts to install). Your kernel choice is kept.
